We’re opening up access to Atlas to everyone today.

We’ve built apps and API endpoints to help you use Atlas any way you can imagine: bring your ideas for building a 3D world and come away with keyframes, video clips, or 3D Gaussian splats.

Introducing Gemini 4 Hydrogen, an extremely capable and fast model built to bring Gemini 4 to everyone!

Available to all tiers of Google AI Studio, Gemini API, Gemini for business, the Gemini app, Google Search, and paid Google AI Pro + Ultra subscribers in Google Antigravity.

This whole thing sucks, and I wish none of it had happened. It’s a really sad day!

But I want to make one thing clear: we’ll keep fighting for open-source AI, harder than ever. This is too important to slow down now. Let’s go!
